heading: How I help
lead: I work with teams that need clearer architecture, steadier backend delivery, and pragmatic AI-assisted engineering workflows.

items.title: SaaS Backend Architecture
items.body: Designing and leading multi-tenant backend platforms with clear system boundaries, practical API contracts, maintainable data models, and delivery standards that survive team growth.

items.title: AI-Assisted Engineering Workflows
items.body: Building developer tooling and workflow automation that help teams reason about requirements, implementation paths, review quality, and delivery risk without turning engineering judgment into a black box.

items.title: Technical Review & Team Standards
items.body: Helping teams stabilize architecture, improve code review habits, raise test quality, and recover delivery momentum when product complexity has started to outrun the system.
